lines.zh: 我没有弩，但我跑得比箭快。
lines.en: No crossbow, but I outrun arrows.

lines.zh: 守灵人们跟不上我的步子。
lines.en: The gravekeepers cannot keep my pace.

lines.zh: 我绕着村子跑第三圈了。
lines.en: Third lap around the village.

lines.zh: 白天我会烧起来，所以夜里跑。
lines.en: Daylight burns me, so I run at night.
I can chase you empty-handed.

lines.zh: 风从我的破袖子里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind blows through my torn sleeve.
Whoever falls behind leaves the essence.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草都黑了。
lines.en: Grass blackens where I step.
Do not count my steps; they are countless.

lines.zh: 我比活着的时候更能跑。
lines.en: I run better than I did alive.

lines.zh: 我们跑起来，影子都追不上。
lines.en: When we run, even our shadows fall behind.

lines.zh: 夜里绕村，脚步踩同一个点。
lines.en: We circle the village, feet striking one beat.
My hands keep reaching for a crossbow.

lines.zh: 二十四点生命，不多，够用。
lines.en: Twenty-four health, no more, and that suffices.
Gravekeepers keep the night; I keep the hunger.

lines.zh: 精华还在我身体里发烫。
lines.en: The essence still burns inside me.
I forget where a crossbow belongs.
The night is long enough for more laps.
Light bones; running costs me nothing.

lines.zh: 我在等太阳升起那一刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for the moment the sun rises.

lines.zh: 我的同伙比我慢，也比我硬。
lines.en: My fellows are slower, and tougher.
Standing empty-handed makes me restless.
You run too slowly.
Armor won't break, but it can be gone around.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛，跟着动的东西走。
lines.en: Living eyes follow whatever moves.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里的弩，真好看。
lines.en: I am looking at your crossbow. Lovely thing.
Step back and I will assume you run.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像没烧完的柴。
lines.en: You smell like half-burnt firewood.
Don't stand still; still things get remembered.

lines.zh: 你也是灾厄村民吗？不像。
lines.en: Are you an illager too? You don't look it.
I count your steps, one to ten.

lines.zh: 你看我做什么，我又不拿弩。
lines.en: Why stare? I am not the one with the crossbow.
Light. Far too light.
No armor. This is no surprise.
One hit, one bone fewer.
Strong hands. Too slow, though.
I can still run.
That blow reminds me of the sun.
Not the legs; I need those.
The pain passes quickly.
My pack will chase you for me.
Twenty-four points, and plenty left.
Don't feed me; fed or not, I chase.
That cannot feed a dead man.
Hold it up; it blocks your way nicely.
Stop waving it; it makes me want to run.
The dead care only about blood.
Away with it; I have other things to chase.
Keep it. You will get hungry.

lines.zh: 我闻不出香味，只闻出活气。
lines.en: I smell no food, only living breath.
Food to me is like stone.
Don't coax me; I won't slow down.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我就换个方向跑。
lines.en: One bump, and I run a different way.
You are in the way.
Light as air; I do not even feel it.
No armor, but I do not fear a shove.
Move; the gravekeepers are behind me.
You scattered my pack.
That slowed me by half a step.

lines.zh: 相撞的骨头，脆得像干柴。
lines.en: Bones knock together, brittle as dry kindling.
Don't chase me; you cannot.
I still have to run to the gathering.
I only run with my own kind.
The dead speak of speed, not affection.
If you cannot keep up, forget it.
I have thirty fellows. I don't need you.
Run at night, burn by day. No time.
I did not even keep my name.
Don't take my hand; I have to run.
My heart stopped, and so did such things.
Go find a gravekeeper.
All I know is running forward.
Dropped things go to the fastest.
I have not even a scrap of cloth left.
Is that essence? No. A pity.
Don't pick that up; I stepped on it.
I have no pockets, only rags.
Carrying things slows the run.
Leave the relics to the gravekeepers.
I drop one essence when I die.

lines.zh: 手里的东西，跑起来会响。
lines.en: Things in hand rattle when you run.
Put it down; I still have running to do.
Slower than a gravekeeper. You will do.
I saw you look back.
Living bodies give off heat. Easy to find.
I need no crossbow. I have hands.
Chasing you costs me no breath.
You are running toward a dead end.

lines.zh: 队伍在集合，先拿你热身。
lines.en: The pack gathers; you will warm me up.

lines.zh: 断枝的响声，替我报了方位。
lines.en: That snapping branch told me where you are.

lines.zh: 同伙已经绕到你后面了。
lines.en: My fellows are already behind you.
Don't run so straight; I can predict it.

lines.zh: 你的血，会留在我的路上。
lines.en: Your blood will stay on my road.

lines.zh: 被我锁住的人，只有一条路。
lines.en: Once locked on, you have one road left.
The village ahead, me behind.
Chasing you beats chasing sheep.
I smell a living one.
You are panting louder than I am.
Ten more steps and you are spent.
I circle the trees better than you.
Not into the fields; something waits there.

lines.zh: 你回头三次了，我都看见。
lines.en: You looked back three times. I saw.
My sleeve rattles in the wind.
Almost there. Your legs are shaking.

lines.zh: 我不累，这是我唯一的好处。
lines.en: I never tire. It is my one advantage.
You dropped the torch. Wise.

lines.zh: 守灵人从左边包过来了。
lines.en: Gravekeepers are closing from the left.
Your shadow runs ahead of you.
That is a wall ahead. Hear it?
I count to ten, and you should stop.
Don't stop; I will reach you.
Your steps are loud in the grass.
I cut through by the fence.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，可惜要拐弯。
lines.en: You're faster, but you must turn.

lines.zh: 白天我身上起火，夜里追你更狠。
lines.en: By day my body burns; by night I hunt you harder.
Hands are quicker than crossbows. Believe it?
This blow is light, but more will follow.

lines.zh: 我打你，只是让你慢一点。
lines.en: I hit you only to slow you down.
Caught your sleeve. Stop pulling.
One bite, and you will run slower.
Bare hands will do; I carry no crossbow.

lines.zh: 你的护甲救了你的肋骨。
lines.en: Your armor saved your ribs.
One more hit and I switch targets.
Don't block; I am just passing through.
Fingernails can tear cloth too.
That one was for my pack.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的步子就更快。
lines.en: Fall back, and my stride only quickens.
Hitting is easier than chasing.
My bones are light; my blows are not heavy.
That one landed on your shoulder.
I grab your collar, not your face.

lines.zh: 夜里，我们一群一起冒出来。
lines.en: At night we come up together, a whole pack.

lines.zh: 守灵人带着我，我带着风。
lines.en: Gravekeepers lead me; I bring the speed.
Do not look for me by day; I burn.

lines.zh: 我没有弩，出来时就没有。
lines.en: No crossbow. I came out of the ground without one.
Thirty of us. Lively enough tonight.
The soil covered me a long while.
I was the first one out.
Who knocks on the coffin lid? Only wind.

lines.zh: 堕落精华在我胸口发亮。
lines.en: The fallen essence glows in my chest.

lines.zh: 队伍集合了，我数到二十九。
lines.en: The pack gathers. I count twenty-nine.
I smell a living thing.
Fresh out of the grave, my legs are still new.
Don't stand and stare. Run.
Tonight we run circles around the village.
It burns by day. It burns now.
A fall is better than burning.
I run badly in water. Don't push.
After the blast I run even less straight.
An arrow keeping up with me? Try it.
A spell has tangled my legs.
I am not hungry. Just hollow.
Lightning is brighter than daylight.
Fall in there and I cannot run back.
